resources.string: %1$s will no longer see this task.
%1$s sees this task in their Tasks and can mark it done and leave it. Only you change the title, notes, due date and priority, reassign or delete it.
Waiting for %1$s to accept. The assignee sees the task once their Zenlygram sync is on; if they start within 7 days, it still reaches them. If it isn\'t accepted in that time, you can send it again.
The daily assignment limit is reached. It is sent automatically later.
Nobody has this task now. Send it again or choose another assignee.
%1$s was saved as the assignee earlier, but the task hasn\'t been sent to them.
A completed task can\'t be assigned. Reopen it first.

The task goes to the assignee\'s Tasks in Zenlygram, not as a Telegram message. They see the title, notes and due date, can mark it done and leave it. They also see your Telegram ID. Your lists and other tasks stay private. The assignee sees the task once their Zenlygram sync is on; if they start within 7 days, it still reaches them. You see their name and what they do with the task.
You can\'t assign a task to yourself.
You can assign up to 5 tasks a day to one person. Try again tomorrow.
Too many assignments in a row. Try again in a minute.
Too many assignments today. Try again tomorrow.
Too many assignments are waiting for an answer. Try again when some are accepted or expire.
So that the assignee sees the task in their Tasks, it is stored on the Zenlygram server. That needs your data consent and a linked account.
Assigning becomes possible in a moment, once sync has started.
You can mark it done or not done and leave the task. Only the person who assigned it changes, reassigns or deletes it.
Tasks from people in your Telegram contacts are accepted automatically. Others wait here for your answer.
